architecture.barrot_v3_safety: Executor uses shell=False and a strict command allowlist; create-only writes; patch/delete/restore require exact preimages/postimages; repository repair refuses unsafe dirty/default-branch operations and gates external pushes through the watchdog.
architecture.public_forecast_safety: latest_signal status is NOT_ISSUED; accuracy is NOT_EVALUATED; legacy 45.5% accuracy is archived as unvalidated; legacy market analysis and signal-accuracy paths are retired; signal_ledger workflow disabled; HF Space tools return NOT_ISSUED and external inference requires explicit operator and user consent.
architecture.xrp_ingestion: 47 public source definitions, 43 hourly, two weekly CFTC, two excluded noncommercial XRPL node sources; 45 scheduled. Read-only collector on integration; scheduled workflow is main-only and not present on main.
architecture.storage: SHA-256 raw receipts/hash-chain and point-in-time SQLite feature store with append-only triggers. GitHub Actions artifacts/cache retain raw receipts/daily archive 90 days and per-run feature store 7 days; this is not independent WORM or trusted timestamp anchoring.
architecture.forecast_ledger: Fail-closed ledger requires Ed25519 evaluator attestation; readiness requires >=100 out-of-sample samples, >=100 shadow outcomes, >=10 non-overlapping target windows in each, two independent source groups, weighted calibration error <=0.05, stable drift and lower Brier/log loss than all four baselines.
architecture.missing: Dedicated scenario/counter-hypothesis generator; independent WORM/time anchor; production evaluator key; mature synchronized historical dataset; independent shadow outcomes; measured out-of-sample lift; successful main-branch ingestion.

disagreement_and_counter_hypotheses: Evernorth's closing treasury was approximately 82.17% in kind and 17.83% cash-purchased; cash purchases are genuine demand but not all 473.276M XRP was open-market accumulation.
The 73.688M XRPN share registration is potential equity resale supply, not XRP token supply; no completed resale or treasury sale is established.
SBI's 11.791M registered shares include 9.432M Class A and 2.359M Class C; transfer restrictions remain unresolved.
XRP Insights attributes 103.130M XRP to 13 Evernorth-linked wallets; 370.347M moved outside the tracked set by Oct 22; destinations are not proof of sale.
TradRadar OI $1.57B and Liqwall OI $1.15B have different venue universes and timestamps; no average is computed.
Positive funding and high long-account shares may reflect crowded longs or hedged carry; neither is a directional forecast.

sec_attribution.interpretation: The three Ripple-connected contributions total approximately 388.111M XRP, about 82.0% of the closing treasury; including 0.8M subscriber in-kind contributions yields 388.911M total in-kind, 82.17%. Only 84.366M XRP is identified as cash-purchased.

resale_registration.sbi_class_c_voting_and_transfer: Class C is non-voting and subject to transfer/conversion restrictions; conversion subject to SBI group's 39.9% ownership cap.
resale_registration.sbi_lockup_status: SBI is not named in the explicit Lock-Up Agreement party list reviewed; separate restrictions/agreements and transfer-agent status remain unresolved. Treat existing Class A as potential resale supply, not confirmed unrestricted float.
resale_registration.proceeds: Selling-holder resales generate no proceeds for Evernorth; the separate Cantor ELOC had zero proceeds received as of Nov 9. Sponsor warrant exercise is a separate contingent cash source.
resale_registration.caveat: Registered shares include potential conversions/exchanges/warrant exercises; not all 73.688M are currently outstanding or freely tradable. No completed sale is established by registration.
